notes: The production notification delegate remains connected through IosNotificationReplyRuntime and IosChatPostgrestTransport. The focal XCTest observes the native request materialized by that path with a hermetic executor; it does not claim a live remote HTTP response.

The historical focal XCTest on Product 5990ff5b observed the exact PostgREST URL, POST method, authenticated headers, JSON body and timeout. The recomposed Product retains byte-identical transport, XCTest and contract blobs without attributing a new execution.
Inside one transport call, only a 401 for the same actor may refresh and replay once. Actor replacement fails closed before that replay, while HTTP 403 and 500 do not refresh or replay internally.
NotificationReplySender retains its existing bounded three attempts for transport failures; this unit makes no claim that 403/500 suppress those sender-level attempts.

The focal contract is wired into test:web-wave2-contracts and test:ci-fast-contracts. The complete local fast suite had two unrelated missing-pg failures in this fresh worktree; final CI remains authoritative for the complete gate.
The optional Wasm Node attempt failed before test execution on the known Node 22 skiko.wasm loader boundary and is not counted as acceptance.
This closes only the exact iOS HTTP boundary. APNs, physical-device behavior, distribution, offline/restart lifecycle and post-reply navigation remain explicit limits.

The unit was replayed over frozen PR #600; the iOS transport, focal XCTest and contract blobs are byte-identical to historical Product 5990ff5b, so the 4/4 execution remains historical and no new platform run is attributed.
